test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - GK/CA (Held on: 22 Nov, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following Articles of the Constitution of India deals with the National Commission for Scheduled Castes?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 338**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Article 338** of the Constitution of India deals with the establishment of the National Commission for Scheduled Castes (NCSC).
 
• The NCSC was reconstituted as a separate entity distinct from the National Commission for Scheduled Tribes (NCST) through the 89th Constitutional Amendment Act of 2003.
 
• The main function of the NCSC is to investigate and monitor all matters relating to the safeguards provided for the Scheduled Castes under the Constitution or any other law.
 
• The Commission also participates in the planning process of socio-economic development of the Scheduled Castes and evaluates the progress of their development under the Union and any State.
 
• The NCSC also presents annual and special reports to the President upon the working of these safeguards.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Constitutional Safeguards**:

 
 
• Articles 15, 17, 46, and others of the Constitution provide specific safeguards for the protection of Scheduled Castes.
 
• Article 17 abolishes "untouchability" and forbids its practice in any form.
 
• Article 46 promotes the educational and economic interests of Scheduled Castes and protects them from social injustice and all forms of exploitation.
 
 
 
• **89th Constitutional Amendment**:
 
 
• Through this amendment, the National Commission for Scheduled Castes and the National Commission for Scheduled Tribes were bifurcated into two separate bodies.
 
• This amendment came into effect on 19th February 2004.
 
 
 
• **Functions of NCSC**:
 
 
• To investigate and monitor all matters related to safeguards provided for SCs under the Constitution or other laws.
 
• To inquire into specific complaints regarding deprivation of rights and safeguards of SCs.
 
• To advise on the planning process of socio-economic development of SCs.
 
• To present reports to the President on the working of these safeguards.
 
 
 
• **Composition of NCSC**:
 
 
• The NCSC consists of a Chairperson, a Vice-Chairperson, and three other members appointed by the President by warrant under his hand and seal.
 
• The terms and conditions of service and tenure of office of the Chairperson, Vice-Chairperson, and other Members are determined by the President.
